name: Broad market decline
description: Applies a hypothetical equity market shock to mapped equity exposures.
method: Direct positions and known fund constituents are shocked once; uncovered fund value is modelled only for broad equity shocks.
limitations: Illustrative deterministic stress, not a forecast.
Bonds, cash, and unmapped asset classes are not shocked.

name: Technology sector decline
description: Applies a hypothetical shock only to exposure mapped to Technology.
method: Only explicitly mapped Technology exposures are shocked.
limitations: Illustrative deterministic stress, not a forecast.

name: US dollar strengthens
description: Models the effect of a hypothetical 10% strengthening of USD against the selected base-currency exposure.
method: USD-denominated exposure gains 10% versus a non-USD base; non-USD exposure loses 10% versus a USD base.
limitations: FX is a simplified parallel shock.
Unknown hedge status is not assumed unhedged.

name: US dollar weakens
description: Models the effect of a hypothetical 10% weakening of USD against the selected base-currency exposure.
method: USD-denominated exposure loses 10% versus a non-USD base; non-USD exposure gains 10% versus a USD base.
limitations: FX is a simplified parallel shock.
Unknown hedge status is not assumed unhedged.

name: Combined market and FX shock
description: Applies a broad equity shock and an FX shock to eligible exposures.
method: Asset and FX returns compound as (1 + asset_return) * (1 + fx_return) - 1.
limitations: Illustrative deterministic stress, not a forecast.
Unknown hedge status is not assumed unhedged.

name: Custom scenario
description: Applies caller-selected shocks to mapped exposure.
method: A custom sector or asset selection is shocked once at its mapped exposure level.
limitations: Only mapped exposure can be shocked.
Illustrative deterministic stress, not a forecast.
